shipped_result.reason: the lake was first observed on 2018-11-09, after the DEM epoch ended on 2014-09-11, and the DEM inside the lake is not flat (sd 32.50 m), so it records the pre-lake valley floor The GLO-30 height-error mask is zero over 62.8% of the lake, so the DEM recorded a water surface there and those pixels are Branch B. Depth and volume cover the rest only, and the volume is therefore a LOWER BOUND on the impoundment: it omits whatever the river already held below its DEM-epoch surface.

comparison_note: NOT comparable: the AOI truncates the lake and the bound omits the pre-dam river's own depth (Branch B).
